problemStatement.formal: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → ∃ x ∈ Icc (-1:ℝ) 1, f x = f (-x)
problemStatement.plain: Can the 1D Borsuk-Ulam theorem be proved constructively? Answer: YES via IVT.
whyMatters: Clarifies constructive status of topological fixed-point theorems
Connects Borsuk-Ulam to Tucker's combinatorial lemma
Identifies the constructive barrier at dimension 2

proven: 1D interval BU via IVT on antisymmetric difference
No odd continuous map to {±1} (1D no-retraction)
Strictly monotone functions have unique antipodal pair at 0
Circle BU is genuinely non-trivial (no self-antipodal in (0,π))
